title: Member Copay Taken on Medicaid Plan Appeals — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — Medicaid Managed Care Plan.** The plan appeal's plan portion is its valued charges less its member copay. The member copay depends on the copays the plan has assigned on the coverage:

1. **Zero** where the copays the plan assigned on the coverage within the last twelve months already total the copay cap amount of **25.00 USD**.
2. **The most recent copay the plan assigned on the coverage** where copays were assigned within the last twelve months but stay below 25.00 USD.
3. **The standard copay of 3.00 USD** otherwise, that is, where no copay was assigned within the last twelve months.

Copays are the patient-responsibility lines of the copay type on the coverage.

## Cases (hypothetical coverages)

| Copays assigned in the last twelve months | Most recent copay on the coverage | Member copay |
|---|---|---|
| 25.00 in total | 2.00 | 0.00 (total equals the cap) |
| 31.00 in total | 4.00 | 0.00 |
| 9.00 in total | 1.50 | 1.50 |
| None | — | 3.00 |

## Reading points

- "Already total" includes equality: a twelve-month total of exactly 25.00 USD gives a member copay of zero; 24.99 USD does not.
- In the middle case the copay taken is the latest single copay the plan assigned on the coverage.
